[close] Book Now Unmute HIGH SOCIETY is an independent fashion house with a versatile approach. Alongside the historic bespoke tailoring practice established by Richard Lim in 1968, High Society designs both ready-to-wear and custom collections utilizing a traditional tailoring experience with a modern lens, blending features for greater functionality, sustainable production practices, and aesthetic forms. Additionally, curated accessories, functional objects, and art are available as an invitation further into High Society’s world. At the heart of High Society’s vision is a future molded by both experimentation & collaboration; fabricating clothing and curating objects that uncover the edges of self expression.
